subject: 🌎 RSVP | New events added to Axios House at Climate Week & UNGA | Sept. 21–23
body_text:
96 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 RSVP to Axios House 
 Hello Axios insider,  

  

 
  You're invited: We've added four new events to our Axios House at Climate Week and UN General Assembly lineup, featuring Sen. Brian Schatz (D-H.I) , Rep. Mike Levin (D-C.A) , McLaren Racing sustainability director Kim Wilson and many more. 

 
🚨 Register to secure your spot . Seats are going fast and space is limited.  🗓️ When: Monday, September 21, 2026 - Wednesday, September 23, 2026 

 📍 Where: New York City, N.Y.  

 

   ⬇️ Register for Axios Spotlight events 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for an event on the intersection of technology, energy and climate. 

  

  

 🎤 Speakers include: NVIDIA head of sustainability Josh Parker , Sen. Brian Schatz (D-H.I.) and more

  

 🗓 Monday, Sept. 21

 
⏰ 10:00am - 11:30am ET

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for an event exploring how culture and influence is shaping the climate conversation. 

  

 
 🎤 Speakers include: Support + Feed founder Maggie Baird 

  

  

 🗓 Monday, Sept. 21 

 ⏰ 4:30pm - 5:00pm ET 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for an event on the policy decisions shaping America's energy future.

  

 
 🎤 Speakers include: National Energy Dominance Council executive director and assistant to the president Jarrod Agen and Rep. Mike Levin (D-C.A.) 

  

 
 🗓 Tuesday, Sept. 22 

 ⏰ 11:00am - 12:30pm ET 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for an event exploring how global sports can accelerate sustainability on and beyond the track.

  

 
 🎤 Speakers include: Great Barrier Reef Foundation managing director Anna Marsden and McLaren Racing sustainability director Kim Wilson 

  

 
 🗓 Tuesday, Sept. 22 

 ⏰ 2:00pm - 3:00pm ET 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 See full event lineup
